Bill.NotesEn: On March 29, 2023, the order for third reading of Bill C-215 was discharged and the item was dropped from the Order Paper, pursuant to House of Commons Standing Order 79 (see also statements by the House Speaker regarding royal recommendation - February 28 and April 5, 2022).
